desc: m1n1 proxy NVMe Flush probe (scripts/t6040-nvme-flush-probe.py): identity gate, nvme_init, read LBA0, flush nsid 1 then 0xFFFFFFFF, re-read LBA0 (must be identical), shutdown. No data write path: the proxy has no NVMe write opcode; Flush carries no data. Decides the Linux flush fix after 211 write1 BAD_CMD (evidence/2026-10-25-t6040-211-write1-flush-badcmd.md): nsid1 OK -> TCB-level fix in apple.c (zeroed TCB, m1n1 encoding); only broadcast OK -> NSID fix; both fail -> write-through plan B with hard-reset verify. Fixture (Mythos review must-fix): chainload the NVMe-fixed m1n1 7de07c71 over the rollback (scripts/t6040-run-nvme-flush-probe.sh, hash-verified), wait for its proxy, then probe. Never nvme_init on the rollback m1n1 a61fd099 (July-25 SError path). No kernel boot.
